name: Apigee Extras Bootstrap
description: Submodule of Apigee Extras that maps Apigee status_property values to Bootstrap 5 pill-badge colour classes via a single preprocess hook.
project_description: Apigee Extras Bootstrap is a submodule of Apigee Extras that makes Apigee portal elements Bootstrap 5 compatible. It implements hook_preprocess_status_property() to add Bootstrap badge and rounded-pill classes plus a contextual bg-* colour to the Apigee status_property element, mapping status strings such as active, pending, revoked and expired to success/warning/danger/dark colours (falling back to bg-secondary). It requires a Bootstrap 5-based theme and needs no template override.
